game_title: Slice Slicer – Fallen Statue Garden Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the slice_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the ancient lock using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The ancient lock reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the ancient lock is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Fallen Statue Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slice_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ancient lock reached with actions_used <= 17.
